ValidationRule.description: Case subtype is mandatory when closing a case.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND('Closed' == text(Status), isBlank(text( Sub_Type__c )), text(Status_Reason__c) != 'Auto Closed', NOT( VLOOKUP( $ObjectType.ExcludeCaseSubtypeValidation__c.Fields.Country__c, $ObjectType.ExcludeCaseSubtypeValidation__c.Fields.Name, text(Country__c) )= text(Country__c) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Case Sub type is mandatory when closing a case.
